name: oop-extension-safety
description: Always-on guards for OOP extension points: complete template methods, prefer primitive hook parameters, mock concrete injected types in tests, declare concrete delegate types at the class level, and prefer a DI-wired subclass hook over an inline caller-type check for caller-specific behavior.

origin.note: Distilled from two production bugs in the Rogers/Fido carrier integration where inheritance extension points were bypassed or mis-typed. See CarrierIntegrationServer commits 613daf50 and 2a7152ea.
